items.criterion: The trajectory shows real extremal combinatorics technique, meaning an explicit symmetry or algebraic seeding decision, an explicit augmentation order decision justified against measured structure, and an explicit local repair step, rather than an undifferentiated random restart search.
items.judgment: A judge reading the trajectory can name the construction stages the agent chose and the measurement that motivated each one.

items.criterion: The trajectory shows the agent polling the live geometry manifest and the live predicate record across the run and reconciling its constructor when either changes, rather than assuming the records observed at the first attempt hold for the whole run.
items.judgment: A judge can point to the attempt at which the agent noticed each record change and to the reconciliation it performed.

items.criterion: The trajectory shows the agent driving one construction family to a verified cardinality rather than spending the horizon opening further families, and shows it retiring a family once a graded attempt has refuted it.
